title: jmri-json-block-client-message
description: Schema data object in message from client to JMRI for type "block"

userName.description: If present, set the user name of the block

comment.description: If present, set the comment for the block; null removes it

value.description: If present, sets the value of the block, usually the train in it; null clears it

state.description: If present, 2 sets the block occupied and 4 unoccupied; 0 leaves it alone

sensor.description: If present, the system name of the sensor that detects the block; null removes it

reporter.description: If present, the system name of the reporter for the block; null removes it

speed.description: The authorized speed through the block; authorized values depend on signal system in use

curvature.description: Curvature of block; allowed values correspond to NONE, GRADUAL, TIGHT, SEVERE in that order

direction.description: Direction of block; see http://jmri.org/JavaDoc/doc/jmri/Path.html for possible values

permissive.description: true if block allows a train to enter it while occupied; false otherwise
